scenarios.name: Show recent search history after clearing a search

the user has searched recent documents for "Part26"
the user clears the search field with its clear control
a Search History panel appears beneath the field
it includes "Part26" preceded by a history symbol
the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software

scenarios.name: Recover from a recent-document search with no matches

no recent document matches "zzq_no_match_7319"

the user activates the Search control
